structure.name: Data Systems · Query Languages & Engines
structure.desc: How users express decisions and how the system solves them.

subgroups.name: Decisionhouse & DeQL
subgroups.desc: A new data-system category. DeQL generalizes the approach to the full space of decision queries.

subgroups.name: Set Selection Under Uncertainty
subgroups.desc: Packages over probabilistic data; risk-aware optimization at scale.

subgroups.name: Set Selection with Global Constraints
subgroups.desc: The foundational work — selecting sets of tuples that jointly satisfy ILP-style constraints.

structure.name: Usability · Learning User Intent
structure.desc: How systems learn what the user wants — making prescriptive tooling accessible to non-experts.

structure.name: Auto-Tuning · Workload Intelligence
structure.desc: How databases tune themselves — recommending indexes, compressing workloads.

structure.name: Planning & Sequential Decision-Making
structure.desc: How classical AI tackles decision-making — abstractions, search, and approximation.

structure.name: Responsibility · Fair & Equitable Decisions
structure.desc: How to keep automated decisions fair and accountable.

structure.name: Temporal Reasoning
structure.desc: How systems understand time in text and queries.
